editorial.description_en: Mist after dark, lit from somewhere behind. Dark and low in chroma, and still recognisably blue.
editorial.description_ja: 夜の霧のような、暗く青い灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.414, C 0.052, h 256.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 夜 (yoru, night) + 霧 (kiri, mist), rendaku to -giri. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Night Mist" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 夜霧. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — fuyu-kage at ΔE00 7.8, fuyu-yo at ΔE00 7.8, soko-umi at ΔE00 8.0. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (76°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
